blurb: Angelita Vineyard & Winery is a small boutique winery located in Angus, Texas, offering a variety of red, white, blush, and sparkling wines made on-site from estate vineyards. Guests can enjoy wine tastings, wine flights, wine by the glass or bottle, and appetizers including cheese plates. The winery hosts holiday specials, harvest parties, and live music events, with indoor and outdoor seating overlooking the vineyard.
